Design: 

```

Now, the fundamental theorem. Let's define the statement carefully.

Note: the typed term substitution tm_subst x s t commutes with sk: sk (tm_subst_env tau t) = ssubst_env (fun x => sk (tau x)) (sk t). Yes (types in annotations don't matter).

The typing context Gamma : list (atom * ty); Delta : list atom.

Fundamental theorem statement:
```
Theorem fundamental :
  forall Delta Gamma t T,
    has_type Delta Gamma t T ->
    forall (rho : atom -> cand) (rhob : nat -> cand)
           (sigma : atom -> sktm),
      (forall x U, lookup_context x Gamma = Some U -> R U rho rhob (sigma x)) ->
      R T rho rhob (ssubst sigma (sk t)).
```

First, let me decide the skeleton term type. Since R is indexed by ty and uses sktm, define:

```coq
Inductive sktm : Type :=
| sk_bvar : nat -> sktm
| sk_fvar : atom -> sktm
| sk_abs : sktm -> sktm
| sk_app : sktm -> sktm -> sktm
| sk_tabs : sktm -> sktm
| sk_tapp : sktm -> sktm
| sk_zero : sktm
| sk_succ : sktm -> sktm
| sk_natrec : sktm -> sktm -> sktm -> sktm.
```

Erasure:
```coq
Fixpoint sk (t : tm) : sktm :=
  match t with
  | tm_bvar i => sk_bvar i
  | tm_fvar x => sk_fvar x
  | tm_abs T t1 => sk_abs (sk t1)
  | tm_app t1 t2 => sk_app (sk t1) (sk t2)
  | tm_tabs t1 => sk_tabs (sk t1)
  | tm_tapp t1 T => sk_tapp (sk t1)
  | tm_zero => sk_zero
  | tm_succ t1 => sk_succ (sk t1)
  | tm_natrec n b s => sk_natrec (sk n) (sk b) (sk s)
  end.
```

Skeleton opening:
```coq
Fixpoint open_sk_rec (k : nat) (u t : sktm) : sktm :=
  match t with
  | sk_bvar i => if Nat.eqb k i then u else sk_bvar i
  | sk_fvar x => sk_fvar x
  | sk_abs t1 => sk_abs (open_sk_rec (S k) u t1)
  | sk_app t1 t2 => sk_app (open_sk_rec k u t1) (open_sk_rec k u t2)
  | sk_tabs t1 => sk_tabs (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_tapp t1 => sk_tapp (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_zero => sk_zero
  | sk_succ t1 => sk_succ (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_natrec n b s => sk_natrec (open_sk_rec k u n) (open_sk_rec k u b) (open_sk_rec k u s)
  end.
Definition open_sk t u := open_sk_rec 0 u t.
```

- Also sk (open_tm t u) = open_sk (sk t) (sk u).
- sk (open_tm_ty t T) = sk t.

Record cand := {
  carrier : sktm -> Prop;

}.
```

```

Definition benv := nat -> cand.

```coq
(* ============================================================ *)
(* Skeleton calculus: erase all type annotations.               *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive sktm : Type :=
| sk_bvar : nat -> sktm
| sk_fvar : atom -> sktm
| sk_abs : sktm -> sktm
| sk_app : sktm -> sktm -> sktm
| sk_tabs : sktm -> sktm
| sk_tapp : sktm -> sktm
| sk_zero : sktm
| sk_succ : sktm -> sktm
| sk_natrec : sktm -> sktm -> sktm -> sktm.

Fixpoint sk (t : tm) : sktm :=
  match t with
  | tm_bvar i => sk_bvar i
  | tm_fvar x => sk_fvar x
  | tm_abs _ t1 => sk_abs (sk t1)
  | tm_app t1 t2 => sk_app (sk t1) (sk t2)
  | tm_tabs t1 => sk_tabs (sk t1)
  | tm_tapp t1 _ => sk_tapp (sk t1)
  | tm_zero => sk_zero
  | tm_succ t1 => sk_succ (sk t1)
  | tm_natrec n b s => sk_natrec (sk n) (sk b) (sk s)
  end.

Fixpoint open_sk_rec (k : nat) (u t : sktm) : sktm :=
  match t with
  | sk_bvar i => if Nat.eqb k i then u else sk_bvar i
  | sk_fvar x => sk_fvar x
  | sk_abs t1 => sk_abs (open_sk_rec (S k) u t1)
  | sk_app t1 t2 => sk_app (open_sk_rec k u t1) (open_sk_rec k u t2)
  | sk_tabs t1 => sk_tabs (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_tapp t1 => sk_tapp (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_zero => sk_zero
  | sk_succ t1 => sk_succ (open_sk_rec k u t1)
  | sk_natrec n b s =>
      sk_natrec (open_sk_rec k u n) (open_sk_rec k u b) (open_sk_rec k u s)
  end.

Definition open_sk (t u : sktm) : sktm := open_sk_rec 0 u t.

Fixpoint sksubst (sigma : atom -> sktm) (t : sktm) : sktm :=
  match t with
  | sk_bvar i => sk_bvar i
  | sk_fvar x => sigma x
  | sk_abs t1 => sk_abs (sksubst sigma t1)
  | sk_app t1 t2 => sk_app (sksubst sigma t1) (sksubst sigma t2)
  | sk_tabs t1 => sk_tabs (sksubst sigma t1)
  | sk_tapp t1 => sk_tapp (sksubst sigma t1)
  | sk_zero => sk_zero
  | sk_succ t1 => sk_succ (sksubst sigma t1)
  | sk_natrec n b s =>
      sk_natrec (sksubst sigma n) (sksubst sigma b) (sksubst sigma s)
  end.
```

Definition fresh_atom (xs : list atom) : atom := S (max_list xs).
Lemma max_list_spec : forall xs x, In x xs -> x <= max_list xs.

Lemma fresh_atom_spec : forall xs, ~ In (fresh_atom xs) xs.

Lemma natrec_sat_T : forall (T : ty) (rho : env) (rhob : benv) (n : sktm),
  numeric_sk n ->
  (forall n0 b s, n = sk_succ n0 -> value_sk b -> value_sk s ->
      R T rho rhob b -> R (Arrow Nat (Arrow T T)) rho rhob s ->
      R T rho rhob (sk_app (sk_app s n0) (sk_natrec n0 b s))) ->
  forall b s, R T rho rhob b -> R (Arrow Nat (Arrow T T)) rho rhob s ->
    R T rho rhob (sk_natrec n b s).
Proof.
  intros T rho rhob n Hnum Hsucc b s Hb Hs.
  (* outer induction on SN b *)
  assert (Hmain : forall b, SN_sk b -> forall s, R T rho rhob b ->
      R (Arrow Nat (Arrow T T)) rho rhob s -> R T rho rhob (sk_natrec n b s)).
  { intros b Hsnb. induction Hsnb as [b Hredb IHb]. intros s Hb Hs.
    (* inner induction on SN s *)
    assert (Hinner : forall s, SN_sk s -> R T rho rhob b ->
        R (Arrow Nat (Arrow T T)) rho rhob s -> R T rho rhob (sk_natrec n b s)).
    { intros s Hsns. induction Hsns as [s Hreds IHs]. intros Hb Hs.
      (* saturation at T *)
      assert (Hnv : ~ value_sk (sk_natrec n b s)) by exact (not_value_sk_natrec n b s).

  numeric_sk n -> lc_sk n -> SN_sk n ->
  (forall n0 b s, n = sk_succ n0 -> value_sk b -> value_sk s ->
     R T rho rhob b -> R (Ty_Arrow Ty_Nat (Ty_Arrow T T)) rho rhob s ->
     R T rho rhob (sk_app (sk_app s n0) (sk_natrec n0 b s))) ->
  forall b s, R T rho rhob b ->
    R (Ty_Arrow Ty_Nat (Ty_Arrow T T)) rho rhob s ->
    R T rho rhob (sk_natrec n b s).

      R (Arrow Nat (Arrow T T)) rho rhob s -> R T rho rhob (sk_natrec n b s)).

Proof of lookup_ctx_fvars:
```
Fixpoint ctx_fvars (Gamma : context) : list atom :=
  match Gamma with
  | [] => []
  | (_, T) :: G => ty_fvars T ++ ctx_fvars G
  end.

Lemma lookup_ctx_fvars : forall Gamma x U, lookup_context x Gamma = Some U ->
  forall Y, ty_free Y U -> In Y (ctx_fvars Gamma).
Proof.
  induction Gamma as [| [z T] G IH]; intros x U H Y Hf; simpl in *.
  - discriminate H.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x z) eqn:E.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. subst z. injection H as HU. subst U.
      apply in_app_iff. left. apply in_ty_fvars. exact Hf.
    + apply in_app_iff. right. apply (IH x U H Y Hf).
Qed.
```
Good.
